title: Roasted Pumpkin Cream Soup with Shrimp
summary: Cream soup of oven-roasted pumpkin, carrot, onion, bell pepper, garlic and ginger blended with cream. Served with seared shrimp, grated tomato, pumpkin seeds and croutons.

nutrition.basis: per 300 g serving of soup, 20% cream, without toppings (toppings add 150–200 kcal and 15–20 g protein)

ingredients.name: Fresh ginger
ingredients.note: author uses 15 g, which is very hot

ingredients.name: Nutmeg
ingredients.note: a pinch, ~1/4 tsp — easy to overdo

ingredients.name: Cream 20%
ingredients.note: author does not specify fat; 20–33% works

shopping_list.item: Spices: mild curry, nutmeg, sweet paprika, black pepper, salt, sugar

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C with convection. Cut 450 g pumpkin, 70 g carrot, 70 g red onion and 100 g bell pepper into medium chunks. Cut the top off the garlic head (45 g). Slice 7 g ginger thinly.
Add 5 g thyme and the spices (go easy), drizzle with 50 g olive oil, toss.
Roast about 35 minutes at 180 °C with convection — the vegetables should brown slightly, that is where the flavor comes from.
Separately warm 300 g water with 200 g cream; do not boil.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins, keep only thyme leaves. Transfer all vegetables (including the onion) to a tall pot, add the warm cream and water, blend until completely smooth.
Taste. Adjust with salt and a pinch of sugar. If too thick, add hot water.
Serve topped with 225 g seared shrimp, 150 g grated tomato, 20 g pumpkin seeds and croutons.
tips: Too hot/spicy: stir in 50–100 g cream or coconut milk, a pinch of sugar, serve with sour cream or Greek yogurt.
Too thick — thin with hot water; too thin — simmer gently a few minutes without boiling.
Lenten/vegan version: skip shrimp, replace cream with coconut milk.
10% cream saves ~170 kcal for the whole pot; 33% cream adds ~230 kcal.
storage: Soup without toppings keeps 2–3 days in the fridge.

source.note: Quantities from the video description, serving from the video narration; ginger reduced from 15 g to 7 g
